selection.summary: Fix for issue #1241: ensure the first input position is valid for a match even on first context usage by starting the reference at 1 instead of 0. Relevant evidence is the compressor internal state definitions in zstd_compress_internal.h (h1: seqStore/repcodes initialization area, h15: match/repcode structures) and the context initialization path in zstd_compress.c (h8) where the starting window/repcode reference is established. Contrib and test-shell evidence is unrelated.

# A limited replacement for seq: handle 1 or 2 args; increment must be 1
seq()
{
  case $# in
    1) start=1  final=$1;;
    2) start=$1 final=$2;;
    *) echo you lose 1>&2; exit 1;;
  esac
  awk 'BEGIN{for(i='$start';i<='$final';i++) print i}' < /dev/null
}

seq 40 > in || framework_failure_
gzip < in > in.gz || framework_failure_
seq 2 32 > exp || framework_failure_

: ${GREP=grep}
$GREP -15 17 - < in > out && compare exp out || {
  echo >&2 "$0: $GREP does not support context options; skipping this test"
  exit 77
}

fail=0
zgrep -15 17 - < in.gz > out || fail=1
compare exp out || fail=1

Exit $fail
